## Notes

Requires RTX 30x0 or A6000 class GPU or newer (4080/4090/5080/5090 preferred), at least 8 GB VRAM with 12 GB recommended, Windows 11 22H2; some plugins require RTX 40x0; ARM64 (RTX Spark) is a developer preview.
